hypotheses.construction_plan: Form the diagonal template M(θ, θ) with one parameter θ. Instances are obtained by substituting θ=1 and θ=2.
required_assumptions: M is a two-argument function whose diagonal entries M(θ, θ) form a meaningful one-parameter indexed family.
hypotheses.rationale: The two indexed calls have identical function name and equal arguments; the structural packet reports a common template M(theta0, theta0) with theta0 specialized to 1 and 2.
